Commentary.Commentary: The openers shared a brilliant stand but once Kedar Jadhav struck to get rid of Dickwella, the innings just spiraled down the drain. The spin trio of Jadhav, Axar Patel and Yuzvendra Chahal never let the pressure off and it resulted in batsmen playing false shots. Mathews kept fighting at one end as he has done throughout his career but could not do much. India will be happy with their work so far and will back themselves to chase it down. Sri Lanka will need something special to stop the visitors from taking a 1-0 lead. Join us in a while for the chase.

What a meek surrender! Sri Lanka lost the toss but were in a commanding position at 139 for 1. But what followed from there was a classic case of top order setting up the platform but the middle order just forgetting that there was a train to be boarded. They just missed the plot to lose wickets at regular intervals. Only Dickwella scored a fifty as the rest were chasing a quick flight home.

OUT! The two-card trick does it! Bumrah now bowls it on the stumps, fuller length, Fernando plays all around it and has his furniture disturbed. Mathews is left stranded. Sri Lanka bowled out for 216!
Bouncer to begin! Angles a sharp bouncer on off and middle, Fernando gets out of the way in time.
Jasprit Bumrah called back on.
FOUR! Edged but wide of the keeper! Good length outside off, Mathews looks to poke at it. He gets an edge which runs down to the third man fence. Dhoni dived but could not get to the ball.
Angles it around off and middle, Mathews defends it from his crease.
Change of bat for Mathews.
Mathews gets in line and punches it to the left of the bowler.
Bowls it outside off, Mathews makes room to get it away but misses it.
Slower bouncer outside off, pulled towards deep square leg.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side for a wide. Indians have bowled quite a lot of those.
Mathews is the lone warrior for Sri Lanka out there in the middle.

NOT OUT! Smart batting! Good length around off, Mathews works it through mid on and wants two. The throw comes in at the bowler's end and the bowler takes the bails off, appeals. Replays show that Fernando was way inside the crease. A direct hit would have resulted in a wicket though.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns for a bowl. The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Vishwa Fernando!
Stays back and turns one towards the leg side. End of a decent spell for the Indian leggie.
Lands the wrong 'un outside off, spins in sharply, Vishwa does well to defend it from his crease.
Bowls the leg spinner outside off, punched into covers.
Floats it outside off, pushed into covers by Fernando.
Vishwa Fernando is the last man!

OUT! Stumped off a wide, the plan works! Chahal was expecting the charge and bowls it wide outside off. Malinga comes down to have a go but cannot reach it. Dhoni has ages to stump the Lankan pacer. That was well planned. Wide signaled but India won't mind it.

Lands it around off, worked towards the leg side for a quick single. Mathews is happy to give strike to Malinga here. Dhoni was smart and alert to ensure Chahal did not throw since they too want Lasith on strike.
Flatter around off, Mathews paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Loops it outside off, Malinga defends it to covers. Patel ends with career best figures in ODIs.
Shorter around off, punched to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, Malinga slaps it to deep point for a single. He looks to be good hitting form.
SIX! Malinga goes big! Patel bowls in the slot, Lasith comes down and launches it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. Mathews likes it.
Flatter around off, Malinga defends it from his crease.
Eases one through the mid on region for a single.
Powerplay 3 signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle for the last ten overs.
Fuller around off, worked through mid on for a single.
Malinga comes down and slams it to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Flatter around off, Mathews keeps it out from his crease.
SIX! Clobbered! Looped outside off, Mathews gets under it and slog sweeps it over the wide long on fence for a biggie. First one of the game! First boundary after 14 overs.
Fuller outside off, Mathews comes forward and blocks it.
Slides in another arm ball outside off, Malinga keeps it out.
Lasith Malinga is the penultimate man in!

OUT! Axar strikes yet again! Angles it around off, the arm ball, Sandakan looks to turn it through the leg side but is rapped on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire rules it out after thinking for a while. There is no review left to use, Sandakan has to walk back. Mathews continues to lose out on partners.
Darts it on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Drives it through mid on for a single.
Shorter on middle, clipped through square leg for a single.
Flatter around off, worked towards mid-wicket from the crease.
Shorter outside off, Sandakan goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Wide outside off, slap-driven to long off for a run.
Floats it outside off, Mathews drives it to the left of the bowler who stops it this time.
Nudges one through backward square leg for a single.
Too full on middle and leg, turned towards mid on. The bowler dives but cannot stop the ball with a dive.
Full toss around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single. Now he has taken a single really early.
Yuzvendra Chahal is called back for a bowl!
Angles it into the pads, to stop the single, fails though as Angelo finds the gap at mid off for a run.
Mathews gets in line and blocks this one out.
Flatter outside off, punched to wide mid off.
Mathews comes forward and defends it.
Works one towards square leg from his crease. Does not take the single. Too early for that?
Flatter outside off, Mathews defends it towards covers.
Fuller and around off, Sandakan gets behind the line and defends it.
Time for Lakshan Sandakan.

OUT! Boom, Boom, Bumrah! Spears in a yorker on middle, Perera looks to play a shot but fails to put bat to ball. It crashes into the stumps and that is it for Thisara. The comeback does not last long and yeah, maybe I jinxed him.
Slants it around off, Perera looks to turn it through but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller outside off, Perera drives it towards mid off. Looks to be in fine touch, despite being on zero.
Back of a length outside off, tapped towards covers for a single.
Good length outside off, Mathews defends it solidly.
Shorter outside off, cut to covers from the crease.
Flatter on off, Perera chops it towards covers.
Quicker on the stumps, turned through square leg from his crease for a single.
Flatter on middle, punched towards the leg side.
Thisara Perera is the new man in.

OUT! The young man shows zero temperament! You may be naturally aggressive as a batsman but you also need to respect the match situation. Patel lands it around middle and leg, Hasaranga hurries down to go big over the leg side but miscues it. The ball skies towards deepish wide mid on where Jadhav backpedals and takes a tumbling catch. He gets up and holds his bum in pain. Good effort nonetheless, he never took his eyes off the ball. Surely, this fielding effort will please the skipper.
Floats it outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Change in bowling, Patel is brought on for a bowl.
Fuller and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
Shorter in length, Hasaranga goes for the pull shot. He gets a top edge. Dhoni runs behind and the fine leg fielder looks to get to it too. Neither succeed and a couple of runs for Wanidu.
Fuller outside off, Wanidu comes forward and defends it.
Four Leg Byes! Too full on the stumps, Hasaranga looks to clip but the ball goes off the pads and runs into the fine leg fence for a boundary. The umpire signals it leg byes.
Wanidu Hasaranga comes out to bat.

OUT! Chamara, oh Chamara! Back of a length outside off, Mathews taps it to covers and Kapugedera calls him through for a single. Kohli runs forward to attack the ball, picks it up and then scores a direct hit at the striker's end with a quick throw. It is referred upstairs and replays find Kapugedera short of the crease. That was always risky and Chamara found out that the Indian skipper was too quick for him. Sri Lanka continue to slide!
The umpire have gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Chamara Kapugedara!
Good length around off, Mathews tucks it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Bowling change, Jasprit Bumrah brought back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Shorter around off, punched towards wide mid off where the fielder misfields and allows a single.
Shorter around off, punched towards covers for a single.
Floats it around leg, clipped towards fine leg for a single.
Time for Drinks!
Chamara Kapugedara strides out to the middle.

OUT! Surely this guy has a golden arm! Whatever he touches turns to gold and this is just another example of it! Bowls a high full toss outside off, Upul Tharanga thinks of clearing Dambulla but fails to time it as well as he wants to. Goes straight to the fielder at wide long on. Dhawan accepts it gleefully and Jadhav has a wry smile on his face. The umpires check for the height but replays show that it was a legal delivery for sure. This could turn out to be the differential wicket.
Flatter around off, driven towards long on for a single.
Kedar Jadhav is back on.
Mathews clips it a bit to the right of the mid-wicket fielder and calls for a quick single. Completes it easily in the end.
Fuller around off, driven off the inner half back to the bowler.
Drifting in from around off, Mathews gets behind the line of the ball to drive it back to the bowler.
Fuller in line of the pads, driven towards wide long on for a single.
Mathews shuffles across and clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Flatter outside off, mistimes his punch towards the bowler.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Tharanga gets forward and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller into the pads, Upul paddles it fine past the keeper for a brace.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Tharanga chips it over the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Flatter around leg, clipped towards square leg.
Short and wide outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Fires this around off, Tharanga drives it back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop it.
Full in line of the stumps, driven towards wide long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Mathews drives it back to the left of the bowler.
Flatter around off, defended on the off side.
Fuller around middle and leg, clipped straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Mathews gets a bit forward and defends it on the off side for a single.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Mathews prods forward and defends it.
Mathews gets a bit forward and defends it on the leg side.
Floated outside off, driven just wide off the diving wide mid off fielder for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Quicker around off, Tharanga goes for the push. Gets it off the inside edge past the stumps for a single.
Flatter around off, cut towards the fielder at point.
Around middle and off, Tharanga prods forward to defend.
Angles it into the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket to get off the mark.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Mathews defends it back to the bowler.
Angelo Mathews walks out next.

OUT! Axar launches a missile himself! Fires this one on middle at 105 kmph, Mendis dances down the track and tries to launch a rocket of his own. Misses it completely and finds his leg stump rattled. The missile from Axar does the job for India as Kusal's rocket crashes even before taking off. The dangerman departs and the Indian spinners have turned the game in their favour.
Tharanga clips it through mid-wicket for a brace this time to end the over.
Short outside off, Mendis slaps it towards deep point for a single off the back foot.
Into the pads, Mendis shuffles and clips it towards the fielder at square leg.
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven towards long on for a single.
Shorter around off, Tharanga cuts it towards the fielder at point.

A stifled appeal is turned down! Flatter around middle and leg, the ball stays a touch low. Tharanga tries to make room and play it on the leg side but misses the ball completely to get rapped on the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Deft! Again flatter and in line of the stumps, Mendis shuffles a touch and clips it really fine past the keeper for a boundary. Good shot, this!
Quicker one around off, Mendis gets on his back foot a bit late this time. Gets cramped for room and ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller around off, driven towards mid off for a quick single.
Short outside off, cut towards the fielder at backward point.
Fires this around off, driven back to the bowler.
Into the pads, clipped towards the fielder at short fine leg. No runs taken. A good over for India!
Wide! Sprayed down the leg, Kusal lets it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Mendis camps back and defends it neatly this time.
Shorter around leg, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single by Tharanga to get off the mark.
Skipper Upul Tharanga is the next man in.

OUT! That's plumb! Fires this one in line of the stumps, Dickwella gets half-forward and tries to paddle it fine down the leg side. Misses it completely and gets rapped on the front pad. The players appeal and the umpire is quick to raise his finger. Dickwella thinks a bit and opts for the review. Replays show that it was plumb and Sri Lanka have wasted a review.
A delayed review from Dickwella for an lbw decision against him. Looked plumb to the naked eye.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Mendis carves it past the backward point region. Rohit gives it a chase from short third man but he was never even close to stopping it.
Short delivery outside off, Mendis stays in his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dickwella camps back and punches it to extra cover.
Fires this in line of the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Three dots in a row! Quicker around off, pushed towards the fielder at point.
In line of the stumps, Mendis defends it neatly this time.
Floated around off, Mendis gets behind the line of the ball to defend.
Flatter outside off, smashed towards deep point for a single.
Flatter around leg, Mendis stays in his crease and clips it towards the fielder at square leg.
Drilled toward long on for a single. Good batting from the Sri Lankans!
Fires this outside off, Dickwella lets this through but the ball is just inside the line.
FOUR! Risky but worth it! Shorter around off, Dickwella presses back and slams the pull just over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. Back-to-back boundaries, this!
FOUR! Fine shot! Around off, Dickwella dances down the track and whips it elegantly over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Flatter outside off with a slingish action, Mendis punches it through the point region for a single.
Flatter outside off, Dickwella fails to cut and the ball zips through to the keeper.
Mendis clips it on the leg side for a single.
5th ODI fifty for Niroshan Dickwella!
Good start this! Shorter around off, Dickwella punches it through mid on for a single. Niroshan makes another fifty and he seems to be in a good nick.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Fuller outside off, drilled towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fires this outside off, Dickwella fails to guide it this time.
Axar Patel comes on for a bowl.
Fires this outside off, Dickwella drills it towards covers where Kohli dives and keeps it to a single.
Drags it a bit short this time, Dickwella punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Dickwella pushes it back to the bowler.
Dickwella dances down the track and defends it to the left of the bowler.
Quicker outside off, Dickwella goes for the sweep but misses it completely. Jadhav makes a delayed appeal in which the umpire is not interested.
Fuller outside off, driven towards the cover region.
Kedar Jadhav is introduced into the attack.
Gives it a bit of loop around off, Mendis gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
A slip is now in place.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Mendis presses forward in defence. Gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball runs through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Shorter delivery in line of the stumps, Mendis camps back and pulls this time. Goes straight towards the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
FOUR! Fantastic batting! Floated in line of the stumps, Mendis gets a tad forward and drives it straight down the ground. Past the mid on fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Floated on off, Mendis has time on his side, goes for the slog sweep. Gets it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Angles it on the pads, flicked towards fine leg for a single.

Length delivery around off, Dickwella tries to play it fine towards third man. Gets it towards the keeper off the bottom half and the batsmen run a single. Dhoni has a shy at the striker's end which he misses.
Shorter in length outside off, crashed towards the fielder at point.
Wide! Good length delivery way outside off, Dickwella misses his slap this time. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Short delivery into the batsman, Mendis sways away and tries to play the upper cut. Gets hit on the helmet as the ball goes through to the keeper.

Well played and a good effort in the deep too! Back of a length delivery outside off, Dickwella stays in his crease and ramps it really late over the keeper's head. Kedar Jadhav runs across from third man and puts in a dive to save the boundary. A valiant effort this and after too many replays the third umpire gives it in favour of the fielder. Two runs taken. 100 up for Sri Lanka!
Back of a length delivery outside off, run down towards third man for a single.
Hardik Pandya is called back for a bowl.
Fuller around middle and leg, driven towards long on for a single. 10 runs off the over.
FOUR! Good placement! Bowls this one way down the leg side, Mendis kneels down and sweeps it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Angling into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Mendis punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.

Floated around off, spinning away. Mendis gets forward to defend. Gets deceived completely and is hit on the back pad. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested as the impact was outside off.
Shorter delivery around off, Dickwella camps back and punches it through the cover region. Rahul gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mendis camps back and defends it.

Run out chance goes down! A bit shorter outside off, Dickwella shuffles across and taps it towards point and calls for a single. Rahul collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He misses but had he hit, Niroshan would have been gone by a mile.
Another good length delivery outside off, pushed towards the point fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis camps back and punches it wide of the mid on fielder. Rahul puts in the dive and half-stops it which allows the batsmen to pick up a single.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed towards backward point for a quick single.
Angles it into the hips, clipped through the backward square leg region for a triple.
Drinks! The home side has begun well despite losing the toss. Niroshan Dickwella has looked good and will be hoping to make a big score. India will want to keep taking wickets.
Fuller around off, Niroshan comes down and turns it towards the leg side from his crease.
FOUR! Nicely hit! Shorter outside off, Dickwella goes back and cuts it through the covers for a boundary. That was too short by Chahal.
Fuller on middle, clips it through mid on for a single and gets off the mark.
Flatter on middle and leg, nudged towards square leg for a run.
Dickwella comes down, almost yorks himself but keeps it out.
Lands it around middle, spins in, Dickwella looks to turn it away but is hit on his pads.
Bowls it outside off, Kusal lets it go through watchfully.
Around off, Mendis gets behind it and defends it.

Well bowled! Slants one around off, nips back in a long way, Mendis aims to clip it through but is cut into two halves. Dhoni cannot collect and Bumrah's excitement is short lived as there was nothing there.
Angles one around off and middle, Mendis gets in line and turns it towards the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis stands tall and defends it.
Shorter in length around off, pulled to deep backward square leg for a single.
Kusal Mendis comes in to bat.

OUT! The pressure strikes and Gunathilaka throws it away! Chahal bowls it around leg, Danushka looks to reverse sweep it. Gets it off the toe end of the bat and Rahul accepts the dolly at covers. The opener is not happy but he has only himself to blame. Chahal deserved the wicket after his good beginning.
Stays back and turns it towards the leg side from the crease.
Floats it around off, Gunathilaka aims to defend but gets an inside edge towards the leg side.
Too full on middle and leg, swept to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flatter around off, comes in a the long way, Dickwella chops it towards point from his crease.

NOT OUT! Dickwella comes down the wicket to go big, Chahal fires it wide around off. Niroshan gets it towards covers and wants a single. Gunathilaka sends him back and there is a direct hit at the striker's end. Rahul is not too confident though. Replays show why, Dickwella had got in with the dive. He is not happy with his partner as it was his call.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Dickwella.
Slower one on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single. This is a really good start for the home side and they can now take the attack to India from this position.
WIDE! Another slower one is spilled down the leg side, Dickwella cannot clip it through.
Follows the batsman making room for himself, Dickwella looks to force it through but gets a bottom edge on the wicket.
Good length around off, Dickwella shapes to turn it through the leg side but gets it towards short mid-wicket off the open face of the bat.
Angles one around middle and leg, clipped towards mid on for a quick single.
Slower one outside off, Gunathilaka aims to force it through the off side but misses it.
Angles it on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Gets forward and turns one through mid on for a run.
Flicks one through mid-wicket for a single.

Outside off, slower through the air, Niroshan fails to cut it through. Chahal is bowling slower since he has the breeze helping him, so the batsmen have to force the pace on the ball. Smart stuff, this.
Bowls it around middle, Dickwella aims to sweep but gets a glove on it towards the leg side. Stifled appeal turned down.
Lands it around leg, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Floats it around middle, clipped through mid on for a single.
Double change, time for Yuzvendra Chahal.
Length around off, worked towards mid-wicket by the batsman.
WIDE! Slants one down the leg side for a wide. India have drifted down the leg side quite often already.
Slower one on middle and leg, Gunathilaka looks to clip but gets it off his pads towards fine leg. A couple of leg byes taken.
Gets across and nudges it through backward square leg for a single. Slight fumble in the deep but no harm done.

FOUR! Just wide! Full and outside off, Dickwella goes after it. Closes the face of the bat in time to get it past the mid on fielder for a boundary. He also hit that with the wind so it did not go to the fielder.
Good length outside off, Dickwella guides towards point from his crease.
Good length around off, tapped into covers for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl now.
Powerplay 2 time! Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the end of the 40th over.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Dickwella aims to angle it through the gap at covers but finds the fielder. A very good Powerplay for the home side.
Slower one outside leg, tucked to the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Slants one down the leg side, Danushka cannot put it away. A wide is signaled.
Good length around middle and leg, Gunathilaka aims to go big but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Places it towards point for a single from the crease.
Shorter and around off, Dickwella pulls it towards square leg.
Fuller and outside off, Dickwella looks to drive but gets a bottom edge on the bounce to the keeper.

Run out chance missed! Stays back and punches it towards mid off for a quick single. Another shy at the stumps at the bowler's end does not result in a wicket. Replays show that Niroshan would have been out had the throw hit the stumps.

FOUR! Well played! Shorter and outside off, Dickwella rides the bounce and taps it between short third man and backward point for a boundary. 50 up for the home side. A significant partnership between the two. Interestingly, this is Sri Lanka's first opening stand of 50-plus runs in ODIs against India since February 2014.

Is that out? Nope! Shorter and around leg, Dickwella looks to pull but is beaten. The keeper collects and appeals since the umpire does not signal it a wide. India ponder about the review and then the umpire signals the wide. Quite strange to view that.
Fuller and outside off, Gunathilaka drives it towards mid off and takes off. Kohli has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Even if he had hit that one, Danushka's dive had saved him.
Kohli has a word with his bowler.
Another shorter one following the batsman, Gunathilaka makes room and punches it towards the off side.
Length ball around off, Dickwella goes for the pick up clip but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single. The fielder was sent back for him for such shots only.
Follows the batsman who is moving to the leg side with a shorter one, Gunathilaka goes through with his pull. Gets it towards mid-wicket for a single. He was trying to hit with the wind there.
Goes wide of the crease and angles a slower one on off, pushes into covers for a single. Very good over for Sri Lanka, 11 from it.
Angles one towards gully from his crease but straight to the fielder.

FOUR! Bad ball and punished! Pandya bowls a length ball around off, Gunathilaka was waiting for it and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. One reckons these two are now going to play their shots, having spent enough time at the wicket.
FOUR! Hit away! This time he beats the fielder! Short and around middle, Gunathilaka makes room and cracks it wide of the diving backward point fielder for a boundary. Good shot, that.
Drifts it on the pads, Dickwella swings it towards long leg for a single.
Lands it around leg, worked towards short fine leg for a really quick single.
Back of a length outside off, Danushka taps it into covers for a single.
WIDE! Slants one down the leg side, Gunathilaka shuffles outside off and that makes it look really silly. Wide signaled. The bowler is not happy.
Short again, following Dickwella who is moving around the crease, Niroshan pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Bowls it wider outside off, Dickwella guides it towards point. Gunathilaka wants a single but is sent back after a bit of yes and no. Pandya's shy at the bowler's end is a wide one.
Goes around the wicket and angles it on off, turned towards mid-wicket for a quick single. Good rotation of strike from both with not too many boundary balls, spots Sunil Gavaskar on-air.
Shorter in length, Dickwella goes for the pull but does not quite time it well. Gets a single to long leg. That was well bowled by Kumar.
A tad short outside off, guided towards the point fielder by Dickwella.
Good stop! Shorter outside off, Gunathilaka goes hard at it but finds Rahul at point who makes a superb stop.
Gets across and nudges it towards long leg for a single.
Tucks one towards square leg from his crease.

FOUR! Lucky! Niroshan Dickwella dances around the crease, Pandya bowls it around leg, Dickwella looks to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge past his stumps for a boundary to fine leg.
Back of a length following the batsman, Gunathilaka angles it towards backward point for a single.
Shorter one on middle and leg, Gunathilaka ducks under it.
Good length around off, this time Gunathilaka taps it to into the off side and takes a quick single.
Slower one outside off, tapped towards backward point. Dickwella looks for a single but is sent back.
Bowls it just outside off, pushed to the right of the bowler.
Fine leg comes into the circle.
Bowls it around off and middle, Gunathilaka looks to swing it over the leg side but gets hit on his body. That was a tad short and hence he went for the pick up shot.
Good stop! Gunathilaka makes room to get one away through covers but the fielder at short cover stops it from going through.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers from his crease.
Good length around middle and leg, Dickwella shapes to clip but gets hit on his pads.
Dickwella shuffles but Pandya follows him, Niroshan can only tap it to the leg side.
Good length around middle, played to point by the batsman.
Fullish around middle and leg, played back to the bowler.
Strong breeze does not help Pandya as he has to abort his delivery stride. The build of Hardik is not quite ideal either. He is slim and thin, so you can understand...
Fuller around off to Dickwella, comes in a touch, Dickwella gets across and defends it watchfully.
Bowls it on middle and leg, worked towards long leg for a single. Pandya is yet to bowl outside off in this game. Must be a plan.

Goes round the wicket and bowls it outside off, Gunathilaka taps it towards covers for a quick single. Jadhav did not pick it up that well else there could have been a chance of a run out. Good start this for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Kumar bowls it outside off, Gunathilaka goes after the width and crashes it through the covers for a boundary. Just shows how good the pitch is. 9 runs from the over already.
In the gap! Shortish outside off, Niroshan picks the gap well with his dab between the second slip and gully fielders. A single to third man results. That was close.
Fuller around off, Dickwella defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Tonk! Length ball around off, Dickwella gets under it and just clips it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. That was hit really well.
Slants it across the batsman, Dickwella stays back to have a go at it but fails to connect.
Better! Hurls it around off, Gunathilaka comes forward and defends it.
Some consistency that! Pandya bowls one on middle and leg again, Gunathilaka tucks it towards the leg side. Yes, he is prolific on the off side but should that mean you bowl that line? Not sure.
WIDE! Continues to bowl down the leg side, Danushka cannot clip it through. Wide signaled.
FOUR! Full but on the pads, Gunathilaka clips it in the air but in the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary. That was neatly done as it was in the gap.
Again on the pads, worked through square leg for a couple of runs. Gunathilaka is off the mark as well.
Beaten! Bowls it around off, Gunathilaka has to play at it. The ball pitches and goes away with the angle to beat the batsman on his poke.

Starts with one on middle and leg, Dickwella nudges it towards the leg side for a single. That bounced a touch more on Niroshan and he took one hand off his bat there. Pandya does have a deceptive shorter one.
Hardik Pandya to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Good length outside off, punched into covers from the crease.
Full and going across Gunathilaka, left alone. That did not quite get up off the deck.
Good shot! A touch wide outside off, Gunathilaka cracks it towards point from his crease.
Full and wide outside off, a confident leave from Gunathilaka.
On the pads this time, Dickwella works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Edged! Starts off with a fuller length ball outside off, Dickwella pokes at it and gets an outside edge which falls short of the second slip fielder. Good start for Kumar!
The players are out in the middle. The two Sri Lankan openers are Niroshan Dickwella and Danushka Gunathilaka. India begin with Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Two slips in place. Here we go...
Time for the national anthems.

Upul Tharanga says that he would have batted first since the deck looks good to bat. Mentions that they need to forget the Test series and start afresh. Is happy that the likes of Lasith Malinga and Thisara Perera are back for the ODIs.

Virat Kohli says that he will chase. Recalls that its been a while they played on this track and remembers that it was last in 2010. Mentions that the ball came well onto the bat during practice last night which means the track has changed a bit since last time. Adds that his luck with the toss is changing a bit and reckons that it is always a good feeling to have it his way. Calls it a happy memory to return to the place where he made his debut. Ends by saying that they are looking to improve even after winning and that's never an easy thing. Shardul Thakur, Ajinkya Rahane, Manish Pandey and Kuldeep Yadav are the players who miss out.
Toss - India win the toss and opt to field first. Vishwa Fernando makes his ODI debut for Sri Lanka.

India on the other hand have already shown what they are aiming for - building a team for the mega event. Virat Kohli has talked about giving players roles and observing how they go about their job. They do start as favorites but will remember that they were beaten by the very same team in the Champions Trophy earlier this year. They will want to be cautiously confident than being complacent.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the first ODI between Sri Lanka and India at the Rangiri Dambulla International Stadium, Dambulla. The hosts put up no fight in the Test series but cricket fans around the globe will hope that the ODIs are not the same. The home side needs to win at least two games out of the five in the series to ensure automatic qualification in the 2019 World Cup.
